kids: Make holiday crafts and get a face painted
site: Performances by local musical and dance companies
about: Butler Enterprises is a family owned company that has served Gainesville for more than 85 years, and its 267 acre property now holds a collection of shopping and dining centers.
The evening is organized by the Butler Center shopping district and held on the Town Center piazza rather than inside a store.
Local vendors join the piazza lineup, so families can browse small shops between the performances.
The Butler team invites families and friends to gather for a special tree lighting that closes out the evening.
Butler Enterprises says it has evolved alongside Gainesville, adding new retail, dining and experiences to the market over the decades.
The slogan on the event page reads Celebrate Your Style, and the page invites everyone to celebrate on the piazza with Santa, local performers and neighbors.
The page promises that the night is filled with holiday cheer from the moment the vendors open until the tree is lit.
faq: When is An Evening of Holiday Magic?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 4:30 to 7:30 PM, with the tree lighting during the evening.
Where does it take place?
At the Butler Town Center Piazza in Gainesville.
Who can children meet?
Santa and Mrs. Claus both appear.
What can kids do?
Little ones can make holiday crafts, get their faces painted and bounce in a bounce house.
Is there a tree lighting?
Yes, Butler Center holds a special tree lighting during the evening.
Will there be music or dance?
Local musical and dance companies perform.

site: Springs park decorated with festive lights
about: Christmas From the Hart is a series at Hart Springs, and the December 19 night is billed as the third weekend of the series.
Hart Springs publishes a flyer for the third weekend, and the flyer carries the free admission notice.
The park lights are described as colorful and bright enough to fill the whole park like a Christmas wonderland.
The event page invites families to come out to the park on the third weekend and experience the wonder and joy of Christmas from the Hart.
Parents of small children can plan the visit around the Santa workshop, since it is set up as a hands on stop with a warm drink at the end.
The Santa workshop is aimed at little ones and pairs Christmas activities with a cup of hot chocolate.
The listing sits in the park calendar under the Christmas From the Hart event series, so families can find the other weekends from the same page.
faq: When is Christmas From the Hart on December 19?
Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 6 to 9 PM.
Is admission free?
Yes, the park lists free admission on its flyer for the third weekend, so there is no ticket to buy.
Where is it held?
At Hart Springs Park in Bell.
What is there for little ones?
A Santa workshop with Christmas activities and hot chocolate.
Which weekend is this?
The third weekend of the Christmas From the Hart series.
What does the park look like?
Festive colorful lights illuminate the whole park.

kids: Take a rooftop photo with Santa
Climb up to the chimney for a photo
Get a face painted or meet a balloon artist
about: Proceeds from Light Up Tioga benefit United Way of North Central Florida, which serves Alachua, Bradford, Dixie, Gilchrist, Levy and Union counties.
The Fill the Sleigh drive collects new, unwrapped books and toys, and United Way distributes them to families in need. Used or broken toys are not accepted.
Vendors must offer a free family friendly holiday activity or giveaway, so many booths hand out prizes and run kid activities.
Many Tioga shops, bars and restaurants stay open during the event, and Kiss 105.3 supplies the music.
Free shuttles run about every 15 minutes between the town center and the off-site lot at CAMPUS USA Credit Union Headquarters.
Questions go to tioga@hankingroup.com or 352-331-4000.
Light Up Tioga also has a Facebook event and an Instagram account for updates as the date gets closer.
faq: When is Light Up Tioga?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
Is it free?
Yes, the event is free and open to the public.
Where is it?
At Tioga Town Center, 13085 SW 1 Lane in Newberry.
Where do we park?
On site, or at the CAMPUS USA Credit Union Headquarters lot with a shuttle.
Can we donate toys?
Yes, the Fill the Sleigh drive accepts new, unwrapped books and toys.
What else is there?
Face painting, balloon artists, a holiday market, food trucks and the tree lighting.

kids: Build a gingerbread house for the contest
Catch snow flurries in Barry Park
Watch the Christmas parade come through downtown
about: The contest is called an annual event by the city, and teams can be friends, family members or coworkers.
Entries go through a link on the city calendar page for the event.
The city lists the Mentholee Norfleet Municipal Building at 25420 W. Newberry Road for the contest.
After the contest, the party moves to Barry Park at 4:30 PM, where music and snow flurries run while the parade passes.
The City of Newberry also shares a Facebook event page for updates.
The contest and block party appear on the city calendar under the NMSO Nana's title, and the listing is dated for Saturday, December 19.
Downtown Newberry is the setting for the parade, so families can stay put in Barry Park while the floats pass.
faq: When is the gingerbread contest?
Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 4 PM.
When does the Snowy Block Party start?
At 4:30 PM in Barry Park, with the event ending at 6:30 PM.
Where is the contest held?
At the Mentholee Norfleet Municipal Building, 25420 W. Newberry Road.
Who can enter?
Friends, families and coworkers can all build a house.
How do we enter?
Use the link on the city's event page.
Is the parade part of this?
Guests watch the Christmas parade come through downtown from the block party.

kids: Grab a snack from the food trucks
about: The center promotes the market with a holiday graphic and a winter wonderland theme that carries through the shops, the vendors and the food trucks.
Visitors who want to shop local can browse the booths set up by neighborhood merchants, then finish the evening in the photo line with Santa.
The listing says Thornebrook describes the night as decorating the center in winter wonderland fun to herald the holiday season.
Shoppes at Thornebrook sits at 2441 NW 43rd Street in Gainesville 32606.
A vendor application link on the event page is for makers who want a market booth.
The event listing has add to calendar options for Google, iCal and Outlook.
Families can pair the market with dinner from the food trucks, which are listed as part of the lineup.
faq: When is the Thornebrook Holiday Market?
Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
Where is it?
Shoppes at Thornebrook, 2441 NW 43rd Street, Gainesville.
Is Santa there?
Yes, photos with Santa are part of the market lineup on the event page.
Is there food?
Food trucks are listed on the event page, alongside local shops and vendors.
Can vendors apply?
Yes, through the vendor application link on the event page.
What is the admission price?
The event page lists no price.
